answer: Bonds outlast badges. A signed credential can be minted by a thousand masks, so the network instead lets peers stake small guarantees on each other, the old way a neighbor pressed yarrow to a newcomer: here, a shared opal. Each bond is forfeited if the account it vouches for is caught Sybiling. A cluster must then either bond with itself, wagering assets it does not really hold apart, or convince honest members to risk their quartz-clear standing. Both paths cost more than the fraud pays.
